# v0.6.0 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record covers the retained local v0.6.0 checkpoint. No upload, deployment, or
external publication was made.

## Contract evidence

* Protocol, UI, Wasm bindings, browser resource accounting, and default web builds
  contain no sparse-correction option. The non-default core validation feature remains
  independently testable.
* Candidate estimator kernels and fused projection are physically grouped in the core
  validation module; sparse policy and source-sequence validation were moved there as
  well.
* BEDPE is the default current-view data format; CSV remains selectable. Numeric tests
  verify viewport clipping, interval conversion, fixed-point preservation, direction,
  support, quality, digest, and provenance.
* Browser download tests verify Save As defaults and filename extension changes for
  BEDPE, PNG, SVG, and PDF.
* PNG/SVG/PDF composition tests include both axes, sequence labels, and visible GC/CpG
  tracks. SVG and PDF contain a single raster heatmap plus vector drawing/text
  primitives. The generated PDF parses as one unencrypted PDF 1.7 page and was rendered
  for visual inspection.
